opening: It's Thursday night. The marketing team got excited and pushed the launch post early, and your pricing page is already trending on Tech Twitter. That six-figure visitor wave isn't arriving Friday morning. It's crashing against your endpoints right now. You should be celebrating. Instead you're staring at the cloud provider's cost calculator with the same expression you use when checking your bank account after a weekend in Vegas. The dashboard shows invocations climbing exponentially. Somewhere
